lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance local maxima; visible as at least three distinct vertical columns of 4-5 spots each, located posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical spot columns, forming a rectangular grid of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, high-contrast silhouettes representing hitchhiking organisms (remoras) are attached to the dorsal-lateral and ventral-lateral surfaces.
